# CANDIDATE: BOS_VIX_SHIFT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A confirmed bearish break of structure (BOS) accompanied by elevated VIX (≥20) and above-average volume (≥1.2× average of prior 10 bars) signals an intraday shift to downside momentum. This combination is not present in the registry and aims to capture edge on downside moves by requiring structural confirmation, volatility filter, and volume confirmation simultaneously.

## Mechanism
Entry: When the last three swing points form a higher high (HH) followed by a higher low (HL) then a lower low (LL) that breaks the HL (i.e., price makes a new LL below the prior HL), and the LL bar’s volume is at least 1.2× the average volume of the preceding ten 5‑minute bars, and the current VIX reading is ≥ 20, then go short at the close of the LL bar.
Exit: Stop at the high of the LL bar (chart-stop), target 1.5× ATR, then switch to a trailing stop using chandelier exit (ATR×3) if price continues down.
Regime: Ideal when VIX is elevated (>20) and the session is after 11:00 ET.
